text:
Aisha: Hey team — prepping partner QBR next Fri. Need final MDF allocations + updated partner scorecards by EOD Tue. Also want to revisit tier thresholds for co-sell credits. Can we confirm owners?

Diego: I can run the marketplace + HW partner numbers. What’s the total MDF pot we’re working with?

Mark: Finance side — need committed vs unspent before we sign off. Do we have a rough pot number to start with?

Aisha: Tentative pot = $250k across APAC/NA/EU. Quick snapshot I pulled:```
Total MDF budget: $250,000
Committed: $98,400
Unspent (requested): $51,200
Available pool: $100,400
```
This is preliminary — Diego please validate allocations by partner.

Priya: I’ll own scorecard updates. Can someone drop the sheet link and the column template we want for the QBR?

Aisha: Sheet link: https://redwood.app/sheets/partner-mdf-qbr (permissions: partnerships, finance, revops)
Use these cols: Partner | Tier | FY23 MDF spent | FY24 request | Activity plan | KPIs | Owner

Diego: For tiers — I propose we tighten activation threshold from 30% -> 50% for co-sell credits. Several marketplace partners get credited without pipeline. Thoughts?

Jules: That change will impact some strategic SIs. Suggest we add a carve-out rule: strategic SIs assessed on tech-adoption + pipeline influence, not just activation %.

Mark: Finance ok in principle if we see 6mo burn forecast and estimated uplift. Need a short ROI column on the scorecard: expected pipeline uplift $ / MDF $.

Priya: Got it. I’ll add an ROI column and a notes field for carve-outs. I can push a sample scorecard by tomorrow noon.

Aisha: Action items: 1) Diego — validate per-partner numbers & propose allocations (due Mon EOD) 2) Priya — sample scorecards + ROI column (due Tue noon) 3) Mark — confirm budget codes + approval path (fastest code for MDF spend?) 4) Jules — list top 10 SIs we should carve out with rationale (due Mon)

Diego: Quick question — do we split pool by region or by partner tier? I lean region-first for this QBR (APAC needs extra) then tier within region.

Aisha: Region-first is fine this quarter. We’ll revisit at mid-year.

mdf-bot: Reminder: MDF request deadline in 48h for partners listed as Priority A.

Mark: Budget code is PRJ-PA-77 for partner marketing MDF. Finance approved fast-track for up to $120k of the pool.

Priya: I’ll add PRJ-PA-77 to the sheet and flag fast-track entries.

Jules: I’ll DM the SI list and short rationales.

Diego: Copy — starting allocations run now. Will post a table in the sheet when done.

Aisha: Great. Let’s sync Tue 10:00am PT for a 30m alignment — calendar invite incoming. @Diego @Priya @Mark @Jules :+1:

Diego: :+1:
Priya: :white_check_mark:
Mark: :thumbsup:
Jules: On it

Aisha: Thanks all — trying to keep this lean so QBR deck has clean numbers. If anything unexpected comes up ping me directly.

(End thread)
